Title: Azure Security Center: Public preview updates for March 2021

Body.Content:
In March 2021, the following public preview updates and enhancements were made to Azure Security Center:

  • SQL vulnerability assessment now includes the "Disable rule" experience (preview)
  • Regulatory compliance dashboard now includes Azure Audit reports (preview)

See the general availability updates for March 2021 here.
